scores.evidence: The s1-lifecycle flowchart (TD) has readable Japanese labels at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-04.png). Every table (s1-defs, s3-table, s4-scopes, s5-checks, practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b) fits the column without sideways scroll (pages/mobile-jp-16.png, pages/mobile-jp-25.png, pages/mobile-jp-26.png). There is no overflow, no broken image and no Mermaid error.

No screen is text-only. Prose is broken up by definition tables, code, steps and checks. Desktop JP chars per line has a median of 42, a little above the 30–40 target. The practice section runs long on mobile: 2 code blocks of 19 and 24 lines, then 2 tables (pages/mobile-jp-22.png to pages/mobile-jp-26.png).

All Japanese. Diagram labels, captions and controls are in JP with no stray English UI. Contrast is good on the callouts and code. Nothing is hidden under the top or bottom bars (pages/mobile-jp-03.png, pages/mobile-jp-30.png). No personal data appears on any screen.

niceToHave: s2-settings / practice-model-settings: on mobile the line `"command": "\"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/.claude/hooks/block-rm.sh"` wraps inside the word (`.claude/hoo` / `ks/block-rm.sh`), and on desktop it splits as `block-` / `rm.sh` (pages/mobile-jp-09.png, pages/mobile-jp-23.png, pages/desktop-jp-07.png). It can still be read and the copy button keeps the text whole. You could shorten the line, for example by giving the path its own variable in a comment, if you want it to break cleanly.

practice-model-intro: the chip `"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh` is longer than a mobile line and wraps inside itself as `prot` / `ect-files.sh` (pages/mobile-jp-22.png). The settings code block below shows the same value, so you could drop the chip from the sentence and point to line 18 of the code instead.
s1-prettier: line 9 soft-wraps on both mobile and desktop (`... | xargs npx` / `prettier --write"`) (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, pages/desktop-jp-04.png). It is still readable.

reader: code-block title bars cut long filenames short with an ellipsis on mobile (`.claude/hooks/protect-files...`, pages/mobile-jp-22.png). The full path is given in the step text, but the title is cut off.

reader: the two practice tables (practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b) get different column widths on desktop, so the A and B values do not line up for comparison (pages/desktop-jp-18.png, pages/desktop-jp-19.png).

reader: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000px, failed /api/ requests show up as ignored network errors, and the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (pages/mobile-jp-34.png, pages/desktop-jp-24.png).
summary: metrics.json shows no hard failures: no overflow, no console errors, no Mermaid errors, no unknown blocks and no broken images. No screen is text-only, and the hook lifecycle diagram and all tables read well at 390 px. Nothing must be fixed. The only small issues are long hook paths that wrap inside words in code lines and inline chips; the copy buttons and the code blocks keep the full value.
